toolkit.name: Freshdesk
toolkit.description: Freshdesk provides customer support software with ticketing, knowledge base, and automation features for efficient helpdesk operations and better customer experiences

tools.name: Add Note to Ticket
tools.description: Tool to add a private or public note to an existing ticket in Freshdesk. Use when you need to add internal comments or public notes to a ticket. Notes can be private (agent-only) or public, and can include HTML content.

body.title: Body
body.description: The content of the note. Can contain plain text or HTML.

private.title: Private
private.description: Indicates whether the note is private (visible only to agents). Default: true

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The ID of the user creating the note (useful for posting on behalf of another user).

ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
ticket_id.description: The unique identifier of the ticket to add the note to.

notify_emails.title: Notify Emails
notify_emails.description: Email addresses to notify about the note. IMPORTANT: Only accepts agent email addresses, not external contacts or non-agent users.

tools.name: Create Admin Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new admin-level support agent group in Freshdesk. Use when you need to create groups for organizing support agents and managing ticket routing at the admin level.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the group. Must be unique within the Freshdesk account.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of group. Must be 'support_agent_group' for creating support agent groups.

agent_ids.title: Agent Ids
agent_ids.description: Array of agent IDs who should be members of this group.

description.title: Description
examples: Primary support team handling customer inquiries
description.description: A brief description of the group's purpose and responsibilities.

escalate_to.title: Escalate To
escalate_to.description: ID of the group to which unassigned tickets should be escalated after the specified time period.

unassigned_for.title: Unassigned For
unassigned_for.description: Time period after which an unassigned ticket in the group should be escalated. Format examples: '30m', '1h', '2h', '8h', '1d'.

tools.name: Create Multiple Agents
tools.description: Tool to create multiple agents in Freshdesk in a single bulk operation. Use when you need to add multiple agents at once. This is an asynchronous operation that returns a job_id for tracking the creation status.

role_ids.title: Role Ids
role_ids.description: List of role IDs to assign to the agent

group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: List of group IDs to which the agent should belong

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Agent's email signature in HTML format

skill_ids.title: Skill Ids
skill_ids.description: List of skill IDs to assign to the agent

focus_mode.title: Focus Mode
focus_mode.description: Enable focus mode to allow the agent to work through tickets sequentially without interruption

occasional.title: Occasional
occasional.description: Set to true if the agent is an occasional agent (not full-time)

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: List of agent objects to create in bulk. Each agent must have at least an email address.

tools.name: Create Canned Response
tools.description: Tool to create a new canned response in Freshdesk. Use when you need to create a reusable message template that agents can quickly insert into tickets.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title/name of the canned response

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: ID of the folder to place the canned response in. If not provided, the canned response will be auto-assigned to a folder

group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: Array of group IDs that can access this canned response. Only applicable when visibility is set to 2 (specific groups)

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Visibility of the canned response. 0 = Personal/Private (visible only to creator), 1 = All agents (visible to all agents in the account), 2 = Specific groups (visible to designated agent groups)

content_html.title: Content Html
examples: Thank you for contacting us! We'll respond shortly.
content_html.description: The HTML content of the canned response. This is the message template that will be inserted when the canned response is used

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact in Freshdesk. Use when you need to add a customer or user to your Freshdesk account. IMPORTANT: The 'employee_id' custom field is mandatory for this Freshdesk instance.

email.title: Email
email.description: Primary email address of the contact. Either email or phone must be provided.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Phone number of the contact. Either email or phone must be provided.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: URL of the contact's avatar image

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for the contact's preferred language

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: ID of the primary company associated with this contact

description.title: Description
description.description: Description or notes about the contact

other_emails.title: Other Emails
other_emails.description: Additional email addresses of the contact

custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
custom_fields.description: Custom fields object. IMPORTANT: The 'employee_id' field is required for this Freshdesk instance and cannot be blank. Custom field keys should be the field name directly (not prefixed with 'cf_').

other_companies.title: Other Companies
other_companies.description: Array of other company IDs associated with the contact. Each item should have 'company_id' and optionally 'view_all_tickets'

view_all_tickets.title: View All Tickets
view_all_tickets.description: Set to true if the contact can view all tickets from their company

unique_external_id.title: Unique External Id
unique_external_id.description: External ID of the contact for integration purposes

tools.name: Create Solution Article
tools.description: Tool to create a new solution article in a Freshdesk knowledge base folder. Use when you need to add documentation, FAQs, or help content to your knowledge base.

tools.name: Create Ticket
tools.description: Creates a new ticket in Freshdesk. REQUIRED FIELDS: - subject and description are always required - At least ONE requester identifier is REQUIRED: requester_id, email, phone, facebook_id, twitter_id, or unique_external_id CONDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: - If phone is provided without email, name becomes MANDATORY NOTE ON ATTACHMENTS: - attachments field expects multipart/form-data format, not file paths

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags that have been associated with the ticket

due_by.title: Due By
due_by.description: Timestamp when the ticket is due to be resolved. Format: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

source.title: Source
source.description: Channel through which the ticket was created.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject of the ticket. Must be a non-empty string.

group_id.title: Group Id
group_id.description: ID of the group to which the ticket has been assigned

cc_emails.title: Cc Emails
cc_emails.description: Email addresses added in the 'cc' field of the incoming ticket email

fr_due_by.title: Fr Due By
fr_due_by.description: Timestamp when the first response is due. Format: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: ID of the product linked to the ticket

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Ticket attachments. Note: File attachments require multipart/form-data format and are not supported via JSON API calls.

description.title: Description
description.description:
HTML content of the ticket. Supports HTML formatting such as

, , , etc.

responder_id.title: Responder Id
responder_id.description: ID of the agent to whom the ticket has been assigned

custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

email_config_id.title: Email Config Id
email_config_id.description: ID of email config which is used for this ticket

internal_agent_id.title: Internal Agent Id
internal_agent_id.description: ID of the internal agent which the ticket should be assigned with

internal_group_id.title: Internal Group Id
internal_group_id.description: ID of the internal group to which the ticket should be assigned with

tools.name: Create Ticket via Outbound Email
tools.description: Tool to create a ticket by sending an outbound email to external recipients. Use when you need to initiate a support conversation via email. The ticket is automatically created with 'Closed' status and assigned to the sending agent to avoid unnecessary SLA timers.

email.description: Recipient email address for the outbound email

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject line of the outbound email

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Priority level for the ticket created from this outbound email.

description.title: Description

description.description: Body content of the outbound email. Supports HTML formatting

email_config_id.title: Email Config Id
email_config_id.description: Email configuration ID to use for sending the outbound email. Can be obtained from GET /api/v2/email_configs endpoint

tools.name: Currently Authenticated Agent
tools.description: Tool to retrieve profile information for the currently authenticated agent. Use when you need to get details about the agent whose API credentials are being used for authentication.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Tool to view Freshdesk account information. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive account details including organization information, agent counts, timezone, data center location, plan tier, address, and primary contact information.

tools.name: Get Agent

agent_id.title: Agent Id

term.title: Term
term.description: The search keyword to find agents by name or email. Minimum 2 characters recommended for meaningful results.

tools.name: Get Companies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all companies from a Freshdesk account with pagination support. Use when you need to list companies representing customer organizations.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1. Default: 1.

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: Number of companies to return per page. Maximum: 100. Default: 30. Invalid values or values greater than 100 will result in an error.

tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific company by ID. Use when you need to view a particular company's details, domains, and custom fields.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: The unique identifier of the company to retrieve

tools.name: Get Company Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all company fields configured in Freshdesk. Use when you need to get the complete list of company field definitions including default fields (name, description, domains, etc.) and custom fields with their metadata.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific contact by ID. Use when you need to view a particular contact's profile, contact information, and custom fields.

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: The unique identifier of the contact to retrieve

tools.name: Get Contact Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all contact fields configured in Freshdesk. Use when you need to get the complete list of contact field definitions including default fields (name, email, phone, etc.) and custom fields with their metadata.

tools.name: Get Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts from a Freshdesk account. Use when you need to list contacts, optionally filtered by email, phone, mobile, company, state, or modification date. Results are paginated; iterate through pages using `page` and `per_page` (max 100) to retrieve the full dataset.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1. Default: 1.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Filter contacts by phone number. Should contain only numeric values; avoid characters like '-', '+', '(', ')'

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.description: Filter contacts by mobile number. Should contain only numeric values; avoid characters like '-', '+', '(', ')'

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: Number of contacts to return per page. Maximum: 100. Default: 30.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Filter contacts belonging to a specific company by company ID

updated_since.title: Updated Since
updated_since.description: Retrieve contacts modified after a specified timestamp in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

tools.name: Filter Tickets
tools.description: Tool to search and filter tickets in Freshdesk using flexible query syntax. Use when you need to find tickets based on status, priority, tags, custom fields, dates, or other ticket attributes with complex filtering logic.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1 and cannot exceed 10. Default: 1. Each page returns up to 30 results. Maximum 300 tickets can be retrieved across all pages.

query.title: Query
query.description: Query string to filter tickets using field:value syntax. Wrap conditions in parentheses for grouping. Use AND, OR for logic. Use :> (≥) and :< (≤) for numeric/date comparisons. Use null for empty fields. String values need single quotes. Do NOT include outer double quotes - they are added automatically. Max 512 characters. Common searchable fields: status (2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed), priority (1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent), agent_id, group_id, tag, created_at, updated_at, due_by. Custom fields use cf_ prefix. Note: Not all fields are searchable (e.g., requester_id may not work); use FRESHDESK_LIST_TICKET_FIELDS to discover available searchable fields. Dates in UTC (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: Get Tickets
tools.description: Retrieves a list of tickets from Freshdesk. Tickets are returned under `response_data` in the response object.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Predefined filter to apply. Possible values include 'new_and_my_open', 'watching', 'spam', 'deleted', etc.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Field to sort tickets by, e.g., 'created_at'

created_since.title: Created Since
created_since.description: Retrieve tickets created since this timestamp. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

tools.name: List All Ticket Conversations

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: Number of items per page for pagination. Controls how many conversation records are returned per page.

ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
ticket_id.description: The unique identifier of the ticket whose conversations are to be retrieved.

folder_id.title: Folder Id

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1. Each page returns up to 30 categories.

agents.title: Agents

bcc_emails.title: Bcc Emails
bcc_emails.description: List of email addresses to be BCC'd

from_email.title: From Email

tools.name: Reply to Ticket
tools.description: Tool to create a public reply to an existing support ticket in Freshdesk. Use when an agent needs to respond to a ticket. The reply is sent to the ticket requester and any CC'd recipients. Supports both plain text and HTML content, file attachments, and email distribution control.

body.title: Body
examples: Thank you for contacting us. We are looking into your issue.
body.description: The content of the reply message. Can contain HTML formatting. This is the primary reply content that will be sent to the requester.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The ID of the agent creating the reply. Use this to create a reply on behalf of a specific user. Can also be used to create a reply as if it came from the customer.

cc_emails.title: Cc Emails
cc_emails.description: Email addresses to include in the CC field of the reply. Maximum 50 total recipients across to/cc/bcc fields.

ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
ticket_id.description: The unique identifier of the ticket to reply to

to_emails.title: To Emails
to_emails.description: Direct recipient email addresses to override the default ticket requester. Requires the 'multiple_to' feature to be enabled in your Freshdesk account. When not using this feature, the reply is automatically sent to the ticket requester.

bcc_emails.title: Bcc Emails
bcc_emails.description: Email addresses to include in the BCC field of the reply. Maximum 50 total recipients across to/cc/bcc fields.

from_email.title: From Email
from_email.description: The support email address to send the reply from. If you have multiple support emails configured, use this parameter to specify which email should be used as the sender. By default, replies are sent from the support email where the ticket was originally created.

tools.name: Search Contacts
tools.description: Tool to search and filter contacts in Freshdesk using query-based search. Use when you need to find contacts based on fields like email, phone, mobile, company_id, or other searchable contact attributes.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1 and cannot exceed 10. Default: 1. Returns maximum 30 results per page.

query.title: Query
query.description: Query string to filter contacts. IMPORTANT: The entire query must be wrapped in double quotes. Format: "field:value" for strings or "field:number" for numeric values. Searchable fields: email, phone, mobile, company_id, active. Supports logical operators (AND, OR) for combining conditions. String values must use single quotes inside the double-quoted query. Limited to 512 characters. Use "field:null" to search for null values. Note: The search API requires exact matches; partial/regex searches are not supported.

tools.description: Tool to search for contacts using autocomplete functionality in Freshdesk. Use when you need to quickly find contacts by name, email, or other contact attributes for autocomplete suggestions.
